_description: Lease assignment from platform - assigns worker to mine for a consumer
_notes: assign_task REQUIRES an auth envelope: consumer_address redirects the lease's block rewards, so a worker with no shared secret refuses the command outright. consumer_address must be EIP-55 mixed-case checksummed. The signature below is real and was produced with the documentation secret 'example-shared-secret' over this message with the _-prefixed keys and auth removed; issued_at/expires_at are in the past, so a live worker would reject it as expired.
